requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles capable of 6,000-page yield for Black and 6,000 for CMY, with bottle size for CMY supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet increased customer demand for higher page yields and reduce frequency of bottle replacement.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with CISS, IDS compatibility, ink formulation reuse.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are validated to reliably deliver 6K Black and 6K CMY yields in standard test environments, with CMY bottle size exceeding 8K page capacity.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure that new bottles provide spill-free reliability during user handling, installation, and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience and reduce mess or product returns due to spills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field and lab tests confirm spill-free operation across 99% of use cases.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement a NOA-F (Non-Oxidizing Air Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a labeled lid, maintaining existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve air filtration and reliability while ensuring user familiarity and easy operation.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F part design, labeling process, push-push compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F meets air filtration performance targets and passes all regulatory and internal reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end users to replace the Print Head Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components themselves without technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce service costs, improve uptime, and enhance user empowerment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes following provided instructions, with no service calls required in >95% of cases.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must achieve a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 printed pages, exceeding previous models.
requirements.Rationale: To provide competitive differentiation and support high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, ink system reliability, maintenance schedule.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field units demonstrate >80,000 pages without major failures under standard duty cycle.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Redesign for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with and accommodate the increased tank protrusion resulting from larger ink tanks.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure smooth paper handling and prevent jams or misfeeds due to hardware interference.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Prototypes and production units pass all paper handling tests with new tray designs.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) as the main user interface for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide enhanced user interaction and facilitate ease of operation for advanced functions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional, responsive, and passes usability tests for all major workflows.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station, with platform changes as required due to the new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent ink aerosol contamination and maintain internal cleanliness and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and service station design, airflow modeling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels inside the printer remain within specified safety and reliability limits during operation and servicing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Durability for 80,000 Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign or reinforce the paper path to support the increased page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation and minimize paper jams or failures over the product's extended life.
requirements.Dependencies: Material selection, mechanical design, durability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no excessive wear or failure after 80,000 pages in durability tests.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable by authorized service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To extend printer life and reduce total cost of ownership for high-usage customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts within 30 minutes and restore printer to full function.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop a new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size and keying.
requirements.Rationale: To support larger ink tanks and ensure reliable, error-free connections during installation and maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank design, IDS system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connection passes all reliability, leak, and mis-insertion tests; supports increased tank size and keying.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop and implement a new startup algorithm for the IDS, with improved air management to ensure consistent ink flow and system reliability.
requirements.Rationale: To address startup reliability and prevent air-related print quality issues with the new ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate >99% in lab and field tests; no air-related faults within warranty period.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define and achieve new print quality goals and depletion metrics to match the higher page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality remains high over the entire life and yield of the printer.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets or exceeds benchmarks for all supported media types throughout depletion tests to full page yield.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for environmental and efficiency standards (at least for PDL SKU).
requirements.Rationale: To comply with regulatory and market-driven environmental standards and enable sales in regulated markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified as compliant with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel by launch.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for packaging to protect the printer during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize shipping damage and ensure product arrives safely to customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes all drop and vibration tests without printer damage.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with a new routing and integration scheme for the ink delivery platform.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink flow, reliability, and manufacturability with the new tank system.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system design, tube routing analysis.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All tubes meet reliability and flow performance metrics in integration tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamics and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update the carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure accurate and reliable printhead movement with hardware changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and accuracy tolerances in all tested scenarios.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Business Models and Solutions
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via multiple S&O paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP).
requirements.Rationale: To maximize addressable market and meet diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports all listed business models and onboarding paths in production firmware.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and SMB manageability features, including support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM in Enterprise environments.
requirements.Rationale: To provide advanced document management and device management features for SMB and Enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed management tools are supported and verified in enterprise test environments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD clients and drivers, as well as EasyStart, USS, and UFD for installation and operation.
requirements.Rationale: To provide seamless installation and operation across customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All drivers and clients install and function correctly on supported operating systems.

requirements.Title: 25/20ppm Print Speed (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve a print speed of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard, and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) modes.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain competitiveness in performance-sensitive market segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets specified speeds in standard and PDL tests with supported media.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp PHA, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp PHA, Magi and Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce R&D costs and leverage proven ink technologies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; print quality and reliability match or exceed current benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Security: Gauss4.xx (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features in the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure device and data security in line with HP and industry standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware design, compliance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes all internal and external security audits for Gauss4.xx compliance.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Utilize EPS foam packaging for safe product shipment.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize damage during transportation and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No reported shipping damages in >99% of shipments using EPS foam.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU to meet eco-label requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To access eco-sensitive markets and fulfill customer procurement requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified by Blue Angel by launch.
